verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The observability lease-label validator is correctly tightened from the obsolete 8-hex shape to the repository-wide canonical 16-hex account fingerprint. The implementation remains fail-closed for malformed labels, uses full-match validation, and does not weaken the existing privacy or rows-first precedence controls. The self-test covers the real canonical producer output, verifies that the accepted row is consumed, rejects the former 8-hex format plus adjacent-width near misses, and preserves full-suite diagnostics by converting unexpected normalization refusals into named check failures. The documentation matches the implemented contract. No blocking correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue is evident in the diff.
